label: re-fed n/x early in copy phase
explanation: A very sparse, weak feature (0.007% of steps, max act 0.18). About 91% of its mass falls in the copy phase, on steps where the re-fed input is the letter n or x (in_tok n/x carries about 89% of mass) and the step is early in recall (recall_idx 1-3, peaking at 2, typically right after <DEL> or one token later). The predicate covers about 85% of activation mass, but precision is under 1%: most n/x inputs early in the copy phase do not fire. Firing is enriched when the following original tokens are d, i, 3, c, p or 2 (for example x 3 d c ...), but even requiring several of these only raises precision to a few percent, so the exact context remains unexplained. It rarely fires in the original phase (a few weak hits around t=3-4) and almost never at <DEL> or late in recall. Activation magnitude is roughly uniform across quartiles; the strongest cases are x/n at recall_idx 1-2 followed by 3/d/c.

scorecard.summary: Weighted combination of 40 cues. Raise it: phase=2 & in_tok=n (+3.98), phase=2 & in_tok=x (+3.97), t=3 & prev_tok=b (+3.07), orig3=d (+2.48), orig4=d (+2.42), phase=2 & out_tok=3 (+2.37). Lower it: recall_idx=5 (-2.11), n_digits=0 (-1.31), to_go=0 (-1.25), in_first=0 (-0.99).
